Definition: from G1266; disunion (of opinion and conduct):--division.
BiblicalUsage: Division is what the word names, and Jesus says He came to bring it, not peace as the world counts peace. A household will be divided over Him, father against son and mother against daughter, and the division is the sign that the gospel has arrived.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the division Jesus brings is honest, not cruel; he does not divide families for sport; He divides them because truth demands a choice, and the choice reveals where each heart truly stands.
